claims.assertion: Mari defines natural walk-ins as consensual exchanges: an original soul leaves a living body and another enters.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She cautions that abrupt personality changes alone do not establish a walk-in.

claims.assertion: Mari says an incoming soul may inherit most of the body's memories but interpret them differently.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says memory gaps can remain.

claims.assertion: Mari says immersion pods can use DNA-linked frequencies to force an incompatible soul into a body, overriding its original occupant.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as a hostile, unethical takeover.

review_flags: The source includes claims about soul replacement and criminal behavior; these are presented as the speaker's metaphysical account.
coverage_gaps: distinctions between natural walk-ins and possession
